turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Hi Sam, can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Yes, I can hear you now. Sorry, I was on mute.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Great. Welcome to the garden show. Today we are talking about tomatoes on a balcony.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Thanks for having me. I have been growing them on my balcony for ten years. The trick is a deep pot, good soil, and a lot of sun. Most people water too much, and the roots never grow deep.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: That cherry tomatoes grow almost anywhere, even in a bucket.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Let us look at your setup.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Sure. This is my small garden on the roof. I built the boxes myself from old pallets.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: That is wonderful. Thanks for joining us today.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Thank you. It was a pleasure.
